papers.title: Nonlinear Inverse Iterations for Spin-Orbit Coupled Quantum Gases
papers.abstract:
arXiv:2601.08990v2 Announce Type: replace 
Abstract: This work concerns the computation of ground states of two-component spin-orbit coupled Bose-Einstein condensates (SO-coupled BECs), modelled by a coupled nonlinear eigenvalue problem of Gross-Pitaevskii type. In regimes with strongly modulated densities, including supersolid-like phases, conventional numerical approaches such as generalized inverse iterations or gradient descent may converge slowly. To address this issue, we apply the J-method [E. Jarlebring, S. Kvaal, W. Michiels. SIAM J. Sci. Comput. 36-4, 2014], which allows nonlinear inverse iterations to be accelerated through spectral shifting.
